name: Local Wiz
author: localwiz

sections.description:
Local Wiz is a smart software that takes your business content, perfectly optimizes it, and creates super-powerful pages that are SEO friendly. Our goal is to help you increase your search engine optimization ranking and will help you to get more reviews from your customers.

Features

  • Create interactive pages automatically via our third party app
  • Interactive Map
  • Quick share to social media
  • Unlimited Users
  • Dominate Local Search
  • Upload Photos
  • Embed Projects Map
  • Fast Mobile Friendly Interface
  • Increase your exposure on Google
  • Use Your Location To Improve SEO
  • Increase Social Proof
  • A.I. Writing Assistant (New)
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • Already purchased SEO Wiz (https://localwiz.app/seo-wiz/)
  • WordPress 6.8 or greater
  • PHP version 7.0 or greater

Steps

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the ‘wp-content/plugins/” directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> Local Wiz. It should display:
    HTACCESS OK!
    DB TABLES OK!
    Otherwise contact us at edesa@localwiz.app
  4. Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes button (no changes needed)
  5. Once the plugin is installed, you’re ready to use our app.

Google Maps API

  1. In order to display google maps on your website, we rely on Google Maps API (https://developers.google.com/maps)
  2. We provide our own API Key for you to use, but under no circumstances should you use the API Key aside from the Local Wiz plugin.
    Terms of Use: https://developers.google.com/maps/terms-20180207

Google ReCapcha

  1. In order to protect the pages and forms generated by this plugin, we use reCatpcha (https://developers.google.com/recaptcha)
  2. You will need to provide your own API Keys if you want to enable this feature.
    Terms of Use: https://policies.google.com/privacy?hl=en-US

How to use our App

  1. Login to https://localwiz.app/app
  2. If you have ordered more than one location, select a location, otherwise, you will be redirected to your location’s dashboard.
  3. Go to Add New Project
  4. Enter the required information and click Save.
  5. Then it will automatically be posted on your WordPress site.

Refer https://localwiz.app/seo-wiz/ for more detailed instruction in creating a project.
Terms of Use: https://localwiz.app/terms-of-service/
